overal.goal: packages/desktop/src/main.ts before-quit calls engine.stop() then app.exit(0); stop() only sets a flag, so a running agent process is orphaned and the task stays `running`, to be recovered as `failed`/Interrupted on the next launch. Use engine.shutdown(graceMs) as the CLI does (bin/src/boof-runner.ts), deferring quit until it resolves, so the task is recorded as `stopped` and the child process group is killed.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

before-quit defers the quit and awaits engine.shutdown(BOOF_RUNNER_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS, default 30 s) then server.stop() before app.exit(0), so a running task ends stopped and its agent group is killed; a second quit request quits at once; lifecycle.test.ts pins the order, the second request, a rejected shutdown and the timed-out grace message.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
